problemSigns.sign: Loading dock door stuck open or closed
problemSigns.detail: A loading dock door that will not open or close disrupts logistics. This leaves your facility vulnerable or inaccessible.

problemSigns.sign: Rolling steel curtain off its guides
problemSigns.detail: A rolling steel curtain that has come off its tracks poses a safety risk. It prevents access and secures your property.
A burned-out operator motor means your door cannot move automatically. This requires manual operation or prevents use entirely.

problemSigns.sign: High-cycle springs at end of life
problemSigns.detail: High-cycle torsion springs are designed for heavy use. When they reach their cycle limit, they can break, making the door heavy and unsafe to operate.

problemSigns.sign: Damaged fusible links or safety edges
problemSigns.detail: Compromised safety features like fusible links or safety edges fail to protect personnel. They prevent proper door function during emergencies.
A malfunctioning trolley or jackshaft operator causes erratic door movement. It can stop the door midway or prevent it from closing fully.
